overall_summary: The site shows promising product variety but suffers from weak trust cues, unclear discount messaging, duplicated navigation, and under‑leveraged social proof, all of which can hinder first‑time visitors from converting.

findings.title: Missing prominent trust and security signals
evidence: Do you offer returns or exchange?
FAQ Is Zorai jewellery hypoallergenic and safe for sensitive skin?
findings.interpretation: Visitors cannot quickly see that payments are secure or that returns are easy, creating doubt about purchasing.
findings.hypothesis: Lack of visible trust badges and clear return policy may increase perceived risk, reducing add‑to‑cart and checkout completion.
findings.recommendation: Add universally recognized security icons (SSL, payment logos) near the checkout button and place a concise return policy statement on product pages.
findings.suggested_change: Insert a line like "Free returns within 30 days & secure checkout (Visa, MasterCard, PayPal)" next to the price.

findings.title: Unclear discount and promotion wording
evidence: Buy 2 or more, get upto 50% off · No code needed
Save ₹120 more on prepaid orders + express delivery
Add 2 or more pieces in your cart and save more- Upto 50% off!
findings.interpretation: The repeated, overlapping messages make it hard to understand what discount applies and how to qualify.
findings.hypothesis: Confusing promotions can cause cart abandonment as shoppers hesitate to meet unclear thresholds.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate the promotion into a single, clear banner with explicit conditions and visual hierarchy.
findings.suggested_change: Replace all three lines with: "Buy 2+ items – up to 50% off + extra ₹120 off prepaid orders. No code needed."

findings.title: Duplicated navigation and absent primary CTA
evidence: HOME NEW ARRIVALS EARRINGS NECKLACES BRACELETS RINGS MEN'S JEWELLERY SHOP ALL Log in Cart
HOME NEW ARRIVALS EARRINGS NECKLACES BRACELETS RINGS MEN'S JEWELLERY SHOP ALL Log in Cart
findings.interpretation: Navigation appears twice, cluttering the header, while no explicit "Add to Cart" or "Buy Now" button is captured in the data, likely confusing users.
findings.hypothesis: Redundant menus increase cognitive load and the missing CTA reduces the path to purchase, lowering conversion rates.
findings.recommendation: Streamline the header to a single navigation bar and ensure a prominent, consistently styled "Add to Cart" button on each product page.
findings.suggested_change: Remove duplicate menu items and add a button with text "Add to Cart – ₹1,425" directly beneath the product price.

findings.title: Social proof not prominently integrated
evidence: Let customers speak for us from 27 reviews
The bracelet stack is amazing! It looks so well put!
Very nice jewellery, looks sober and beautiful. Very stylish and non allergic.
findings.interpretation: Customer reviews exist but are buried in a separate section and not tied to individual products.
findings.hypothesis: When shoppers cannot see relevant reviews near the product, they miss reassurance, potentially reducing confidence to buy.
findings.recommendation: Display a summary rating and a few highlighted reviews directly on each product page, with a link to view all.
findings.suggested_change: Add a star rating (e.g., 4.8/5) and excerpt: "'Very nice jewellery, looks sober and beautiful' – Kajori" under the product description.

top_3_priorities: Missing prominent trust and security signals
Duplicated navigation and absent primary CTA
